notes.title: Sinoda 0.1.6 Update, New Languages, Achievements and Cosmetics
notes.content:
[p][b]Sinoda 0.1.6 Update[/b] 

Once again a big thank you to everyone enjoying Sinoda so far, today we’re releasing a new update including support for 5 new languages, new dice colors, table customization, new achievements and more.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added support for the following languages:[/p][list][*][p] Chinese Traditional[/p][/*][*][p] Chinese Simplified[/p][/*][*][p] Korean[/p][/*][*][p] Japanese[/p][/*][*][p] Russian[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added 7 new achievements.[/p][/*][*][p]Added black and white dice colors.[/p][/*][*][p]Added table carpet customization.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a FPS cap setting on the gameplay settings page.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Half Mad King mode, upgraded pieces should now have the same starting layout for each player.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Scrolling in chat no longer changes the camera zoom level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock where the game would wait indefinitely for you to make a move, even if your pieces are trapped and there are no valid moves to be made in double action mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to claim win by Sinoda after ending the game through a different ending condition.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p]

notes.title: 0.1.5 Bug fixes and QOL
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a close game confirmation pop up.
[*] Added the colorblind stickers to the dice color menu when colorblind mode is active.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the tutorial player not capturing your piece.
[*] Fixed the invite player screen not scaling properly on ultra wide monitors.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.4 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[p]A big thank you to everyone who has played and enjoyed Sinoda so far, today we're patching up some bugs and issues.  

[b]Bug fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a max name length to the AI and local player namefields, no more setting the entire bee movie script as a name, I’m looking at you Sky.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed slightly longer names not looking great on the endgame scoreboard.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pressing escape not closing the connection lost and lobby invite screens.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AI players cheating in online Double Action games.
[/p][/*][/list]
